chapter.title: Results
chapter.subtitle: Checks first, then the real test
chapter.sub: Chapter eight: results. First the checks, then the real test.
chapter.tts: Chapter eight, results. First the checks, then the real test.

lines.sub: We start with the same-window check.
lines.tts: We start with the same-window check.

lines.sub: Each row is a score: EndorseRank on top, AWP at the bottom.
lines.tts: Each row is a score. EndorseRank on top, A W P at the bottom.

lines.sub: Each column is a proxy family: transfer, allowance and Sybil stability.
lines.tts: Each column is a proxy family. Transfer, allowance and Sybil stability.

lines.sub: The darker a cell, the larger Kendall's τ.
lines.tts: The darker a cell, the larger Kendall's tau.

lines.sub: I'll leave the middle row empty for a moment.
lines.tts: I'll leave the middle row empty for a moment.

lines.sub: EndorseRank agrees best with the allowance proxies, at 0.585.
lines.tts: EndorseRank agrees best with the allowance proxies, at zero point five eight five.

lines.sub: AWP agrees best with the transfer proxies, at 0.572.
lines.tts: A W P agrees best with the transfer proxies, at zero point five seven two.

lines.sub: The two cells with the little mirror icon are each score's own family.
lines.tts: The two cells with the little mirror icon are each score's own family.

lines.sub: EndorseRank walks the allowance edges, and AWP walks the transfer edges.
lines.tts: EndorseRank walks the allowance edges, and A W P walks the transfer edges.

lines.sub: Swap the families, and the values drop sharply.
lines.tts: Swap the families, and the values drop sharply.

lines.sub: EndorseRank on the transfer family gets only 0.158.
lines.tts: EndorseRank on the transfer family gets only zero point one five eight.

lines.sub: AWP on the allowance family gets only 0.193.
lines.tts: A W P on the allowance family gets only zero point one nine three.

lines.sub: Pair the two scores on the same proxies and subtract. The difference is about 0.4, with a narrow interval.
lines.tts: Pair the two scores on the same proxies and subtract. The difference is about zero point four, with a narrow interval.

lines.sub: This difference was not a comparison fixed in advance.
lines.tts: This difference was not a comparison fixed in advance.

lines.sub: Now the middle row fills in: C-PR at λ = 0.5, which walks both edge types, mixed.
lines.tts: Now the middle row fills in. C P R at lambda equals zero point five, which walks both edge types, mixed.

lines.sub: On every family, it lies between the two rows.
lines.tts: On every family, it lies between the two rows.

lines.sub: 0.365 on transfer, 0.477 on allowance, and 0.142 on Sybil stability.
lines.tts: Zero point three six five on transfer, zero point four seven seven on allowance, and zero point one four two on Sybil stability.

lines.sub: The small amber and sky-blue triangles on the middle row's scales show where EndorseRank and AWP sit.
lines.tts: The small amber and sky-blue triangles on the middle row's scales show where EndorseRank and A W P sit.

lines.sub: But the proxies here were built from the same records as the scores.
lines.tts: But the proxies here were built from the same records as the scores.

lines.sub: So part of this agreement comes about by itself.
lines.tts: So part of this agreement comes about by itself.

lines.sub: That makes it a check that each score measures what it was built to measure.
lines.tts: That makes it a check that each score measures what it was built to measure.

lines.sub: In other words, an intended-construct check.
lines.tts: In other words, an intended-construct check.

lines.sub: It is not an external test.
lines.tts: It is not an external test.

lines.sub: Next question: do the two scores put the same contracts in the same order?
lines.tts: Next question. Do the two scores put the same contracts in the same order?

lines.sub: The two rows of the previous slide break into points and become a cloud of 15,107 contracts.
lines.tts: The two rows of the previous slide break into points, and become a cloud of fifteen thousand one hundred and seven contracts.

lines.sub: One point is one contract.
lines.tts: One point is one contract.

lines.sub: Seen from above, the cloud becomes a flat picture.
lines.tts: Seen from above, the cloud becomes a flat picture.

lines.sub: Across is the rank by EndorseRank, and up is the rank by AWP.
lines.tts: Across is the rank by EndorseRank, and up is the rank by A W P.

lines.sub: Both are turned into percentiles.
lines.tts: Both are turned into percentiles.

lines.sub: Amber points are contracts that EndorseRank ranks higher.
lines.tts: Amber points are contracts that EndorseRank ranks higher.

lines.sub: Sky-blue points are contracts that AWP ranks higher.
lines.tts: Sky-blue points are contracts that A W P ranks higher.

lines.sub: If the two ranks were the same, the points would gather on this diagonal.
lines.tts: If the two ranks were the same, the points would gather on this diagonal.

lines.sub: But look how widely they are spread.
lines.tts: But look how widely they are spread.

lines.sub: Kendall's τ is 0.174.
lines.tts: Kendall's tau is zero point one seven four.

lines.sub: That is clearly above 0, and far from 1.
lines.tts: That is clearly above zero, and far from one.

lines.sub: The two orders are related, but they are not the same order.
lines.tts: The two orders are related, but they are not the same order.

lines.sub: There are more than 110 million contract pairs.
lines.tts: There are more than one hundred ten million contract pairs.

lines.sub: 96.7% of them are ordered by both scores, meaning neither score ties them.
lines.tts: Ninety-six point seven percent of them are ordered by both scores, meaning neither score ties them.

lines.sub: And of those, 41.2% are in the opposite order.
lines.tts: And of those, forty-one point two percent are in the opposite order.

lines.sub: One score puts contract A above B, while the other puts B above A.
lines.tts: One score puts contract A above B, while the other puts B above A.

lines.sub: The thirty pairs flashing on the plot are only an illustration.
lines.tts: The thirty pairs flashing on the plot are only an illustration.

lines.sub: The final value is the result over all pairs.
lines.tts: The final value is the result over all pairs.

lines.sub: Related, but not interchangeable.
lines.tts: Related, but not interchangeable.

lines.sub: The column at the far left is the 535 contracts with an EndorseRank of zero.
lines.tts: The column at the far left is the five hundred thirty-five contracts with an EndorseRank of zero.

lines.sub: The row at the bottom is the 2,672 contracts with an AWP of zero.
lines.tts: The row at the bottom is the two thousand six hundred seventy-two contracts with an A W P of zero.

lines.sub: All zero-score contracts are tied, so they share the lowest ranks and sit in the middle of those ranks.
lines.tts: All zero-score contracts are tied, so they share the lowest ranks and sit in the middle of those ranks.

lines.sub: That's why the AWP zero row sits at about 9, not at 0.
lines.tts: That's why the A W P zero row sits at about nine, not at zero.

lines.sub: And the EndorseRank zero column sits at about 2.
lines.tts: And the EndorseRank zero column sits at about two.

lines.sub: Under the isolated-node rule, which keeps contracts outside a graph as nodes with no edges, τ stayed at 0.174.
lines.tts: Under the isolated-node rule, which keeps contracts outside a graph as nodes with no edges, tau stayed at zero point one seven four.

lines.sub: The two graphs are built differently, so different orders are partly expected.
lines.tts: The two graphs are built differently, so different orders are partly expected.

lines.sub: In the registered analysis, τ was 0.217.
lines.tts: In the registered analysis, tau was zero point two one seven.

lines.sub: Now the real test: the out-of-window test.
lines.tts: Now the real test, the out-of-window test.

lines.sub: The thesis calls it a temporal holdout.
lines.tts: The thesis calls it a temporal holdout.

card.title: Temporal holdout
card.body: Hold back a later period, then check earlier-built scores on it

lines.sub: The three-year calendar is back.
lines.tts: The three-year calendar is back.

lines.sub: The amber stream is the allowance records of each month, and the sky-blue stream the transfer records.
lines.tts: The amber stream is the allowance records of each month, and the sky-blue stream the transfer records.

lines.sub: On 31 March, we freeze the scores.
lines.tts: On the thirty-first of March, we freeze the scores.

lines.sub: We build them only from the records up to that day, and do not touch them afterwards.
lines.tts: We build them only from the records up to that day, and do not touch them afterwards.

lines.sub: Below, example contracts keep their frozen scores.
lines.tts: Below, example contracts keep their frozen scores.

lines.sub: This first holdout, set aside after the freeze to check the scores against, is called W0.
lines.tts: This first holdout, set aside after the freeze to check the scores against, is called W zero.

lines.sub: This test has 17,050 spender contracts.
lines.tts: This test has seventeen thousand and fifty spender contracts.

lines.sub: Then we grade each spender contract by what newly happened to it from April to June.
lines.tts: Then we grade each spender contract by what newly happened to it from April to June.

lines.sub: There are two labels.
lines.tts: There are two labels.

lines.sub: The first counts new approval pairs: allowances between an owner and the spender that did not exist on the freeze date.
lines.tts: The first counts new approval pairs, allowances between an owner and the spender that did not exist on the freeze date.

lines.sub: The second counts new transfer senders: addresses that sent it a transfer for the first time.
lines.tts: The second counts new transfer senders, addresses that sent it a transfer for the first time.

lines.sub: On the right, one dot stands for 10 contracts.
lines.tts: On the right, one dot stands for ten contracts.

lines.sub: 2,070 contracts, or 12.1%, gained new approval pairs: the amber dots.
lines.tts: Two thousand and seventy contracts, or twelve point one percent, gained new approval pairs, the amber dots.

lines.sub: 1,695 contracts, or 9.9%, gained new transfer senders: the sky-blue rings.
lines.tts: One thousand six hundred ninety-five contracts, or nine point nine percent, gained new transfer senders, the sky-blue rings.

lines.sub: Many contracts, 1,173, gained both labels, so many amber dots wear a ring.
lines.tts: Many contracts, one thousand one hundred seventy-three, gained both labels, so many amber dots wear a ring.

lines.sub: Only about one contract in ten has a label.
lines.tts: Only about one contract in ten has a label.

lines.sub: So the results depend heavily on how well a score ranks these few contracts near the top.
lines.tts: So the results depend heavily on how well a score ranks these few contracts near the top.

lines.sub: We ran the same test once more, freezing on 30 June and labeling July to September.
lines.tts: We ran the same test once more, freezing on the thirtieth of June, and labeling July to September.

lines.sub: This is the registered window, W1.
lines.tts: This is the registered window, W one.

lines.sub: This study extracted the logs of these three months only after it had registered the rules.
lines.tts: This study extracted the logs of these three months only after it had registered the rules.

lines.sub: There are 18,152 spender contracts.
lines.tts: There are eighteen thousand one hundred fifty-two spender contracts.

lines.sub: So how did the frozen scores do? Let's start with the transfer side.
lines.tts: So how did the frozen scores do? Let's start with the transfer side.

lines.sub: The left panel shows how well each score predicted what happened later.
lines.tts: The left panel shows how well each score predicted what happened later.

lines.sub: The right panel shows the difference between the two scores, paired on the same contracts.
lines.tts: The right panel shows the difference between the two scores, paired on the same contracts.

lines.sub: If the difference lies right of 0, the walk score, here AWP, is better.
lines.tts: If the difference lies right of zero, the walk score, here A W P, is better.

lines.sub: If it lies left of 0, the raw count is better.
lines.tts: If it lies left of zero, the raw count is better.

lines.sub: The top row is W0, and the bottom row is W1.
lines.tts: The top row is W zero, and the bottom row is W one.

lines.sub: The job here is predicting the addresses that will newly send transfers.
lines.tts: The job here is predicting the addresses that will newly send transfers.

lines.sub: In W0, AWP reaches 0.346.
lines.tts: In W zero, A W P reaches zero point three four six.

lines.sub: The transfer in-degree simply counts the addresses that sent transfers.
lines.tts: The transfer in-degree simply counts the addresses that sent transfers.

lines.sub: It reaches 0.303.
lines.tts: It reaches zero point three zero three.

lines.sub: The paired difference is +0.043.
lines.tts: The paired difference is plus zero point zero four three.

lines.sub: The whole interval lies right of 0, on the walk-score side.
lines.tts: The whole interval lies right of zero, on the walk-score side.

lines.sub: In W1, AWP was again higher, by 0.022.
lines.tts: In W one, A W P was again higher, by zero point zero two two.

lines.sub: And again, the interval stays entirely right of 0.
lines.tts: And again, the interval stays entirely right of zero.

lines.sub: On the transfer side, the walk added information that the plain count does not have.
lines.tts: On the transfer side, the walk added information that the plain count does not have.

lines.sub: Here the walk means the time and value weights, plus restarts at active senders.
lines.tts: Here the walk means the time and value weights, plus restarts at active senders.

lines.sub: What if we look only at the 14,094 contracts in W0 that had received a transfer?
lines.tts: What if we look only at the fourteen thousand and ninety-four contracts in W zero that had received a transfer?

lines.sub: The difference held, at +0.056.
lines.tts: The difference held, at plus zero point zero five six.

lines.sub: The small gray hollow dots, just under the top two white dots, are the values of the registered analysis, and they point the same way.
lines.tts: The small gray hollow dots, just under the top two white dots, are the values of the registered analysis, and they point the same way.

lines.sub: But all the new-sender comparisons on this slide, in both W0 and W1, were in neither the plan nor the registration.
lines.tts: But all the new-sender comparisons on this slide, in both W zero and W one, were in neither the plan nor the registration.

lines.sub: They were computed after the labels were known, so they are post hoc.
lines.tts: They were computed after the labels were known, so they are post hoc.

card.body: Worked out after the results were known, not planned in advance
